'''Stage II Rooters''' are a type of [[Mobs]], placed into the [[Nexus Parasites|Nexus]] Tier.

== ''Spawning'' ==
*Spawns after a [[Stage I Rooter]] evolves.
*If at least one [[Colony]] exists, spawns when a [[Stage III Rooter]] is killed.

== ''Behavior'' ==
WIP 

*Grows into a [[Stage III Rooter]] after 240-300 seconds.
*Stage II Rooters throw 4 bombs around them when damaged, this has a cooldown of 5 seconds. The bombs inflict 7 damage each and place an effect cloud of stacking [[Viral]] and Poison.
*Stage II Rooters can break blocks that have their [[Hardness]] Value up to 5.5, with a 20 ticks cooldown and 2 Blocks range.
*Stage II Rooters will permanently upgrade parasites by increasing their generation to the max value.
*Stage II Rooters will hide their tentacles if terrain is too small for them.
*Stage II Rooters will apply the following effects to parasites:
**[[Pivot]] II (0:15)
**[[Parate]] II (0:15)
*Stage II Rooters can summon [[Rootmass Cyst]] when received damage.
* Upon death, if at least one [[Colony]] exists in the dimension, Stage II Rooters will turn into [[Stage I Rooter|Stage I Rooters]].

=== ''Weaknesses'' ===
*Stage II Rooters, like any other [[Mobs|Mob]], present a weakness to Fire. Damage inflicted by Fire is quadrupled.
